dcat_keyword_sm: A city that is more connected with reliable safe and accessible mobility options
dct_description_sm:
Summary: Schedule data for OC Transpo buses and O-Trains is available in General Transit Feed Specification (GTFS) format. Schedule data includes departure times, route patterns, and bus stop locations (longitude and latitude). Generally, the data reflects the current service which runs for a duration of approx. 2-4 months. Service dates are noted in the calendar file.
Learn more about the schedule and GTFS format on OC Transpo’s Developer page.

Note: This is a reference to the OC Transpo GTFS feed. There is no data to be downloaded on this page.

Accuracy: Does not include ad hoc and/or temporary service changes.

Update Frequency: At the beginning of each seasonal service change, then as needed throughout the season.

Contact: OC Transpo
